name: Pocket Money
tagline: A budgeting app with saving goals and product scanning to log spending.

awards: Hidden Challenge: Least Vibecoded Project - By CISE Professor

solution: A React Native app with a finance questionnaire, editable budget dashboard and barcode scanning for groceries.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan an item and see it added to the budget.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Hidden Challenge: Least Vibecoded Project - By CISE Professor” among 112 submissions.
Won a professor's prize for least AI-generated code.

lessons: Hand-written, clean code can be its own award.
